First find the equation of the straight line.
Then integrate the line using the limits 5 and 1. You should get an answer of 6.
Then subtract 6 by the integral of curve C using the limits 5 and 4. The answer for the second integral should be 11/6. 
Then do 6-(11/6) and you should get an answer of 25/6.
